AppShell.Root.report: AppShell is made of parts in 1.0: AppShell.Root around AppShell.SkipLinks, a Sidebar.Root with the navigation, an AppShell.Header with the title and actions and an AppShell.Main with the page; move the props of one that spreads props by hand, as the migration guide's app frame section shows.

reports.storageKey: storageKey is persist in 1.0, which keeps both sidebars in one entry in a new format, so the remembered preference resets once.
reports.sidebarWidth: sidebarWidth and onSidebarWidthChange are in rem in 1.0, not pixels: divide by 16, or by the root font size.
reports.minWidth: sidebarMinWidth and sidebarMaxWidth are minWidth and maxWidth in rem in 1.0: the codemod divides the expression by 16; check it.
reports.label: Sidebar.Root needs a label, and the AppShell had no navigationLabel: the codemod named its sidebar Navigation; name it by its content.
reports.ambiguous: AppShell.Root has none of the props only 0.x's AppShell took, so the codemod can't tell a 0.x AppShell that v1-names renamed from a 1.0 one, and left it as it is: if it is 0.x's, put its page in AppShell.Main and add AppShell.SkipLinks and AppShell.Header, as the migration guide's app frame section shows.
reports.topbar: topbar is an expression, so the codemod can't tell where the mark and the context go: it placed them for the split topbar (headerSpan="main"); move them to AppShell.Header's start for headerSpan="full".

AppShellSkeleton.report: AppShellSkeleton is gone in 1.0: render the frame's parts with NavList.Skeleton in Sidebar.Content inside a LoadingState; move the props of one that spreads props by hand.

reports.label: Sidebar.Root needs a label; the codemod named the skeleton's sidebar Navigation: use the real sidebar's label.
